spec_match.rationale: Arbitrary validated MIME types genuinely served and classified through contentType; the validity precondition of the spec rule is enforced by the server's real 400.

interactive.rationale: Select + free-text subtype, real fetch per submission, live served/observed readouts and a session history list.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises serve-your-own with the real 400 path; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid token → server 400 surfaced with reason; raw-type pre-158 answer, empty-string answer, own-bucket answer and missing-API branch all distinctly explained.

references.rationale: Every page links chromestatus.com/feature/5092584283308032 plus the exact mimesniff sections.

conformance.rationale: New 7-assertion suite fetches real same-origin responses from the co-located serve route and checks the browser's own contentType: the two new-rule contracts, the application/* continuity contract, the svg exception, and a non-XML control; verified executing 5 pass / 2 honest fails on pre-158 Chromium 141.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on every outcome (matrix ran, custom classified/rejected, audit ran, missing-API branches); consoles clean through all interactions.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; button bg+color overridden together; muted/empty states use --text-muted on light backgrounds (AA).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 through every control: 0px horizontal overflow, zero console errors on all six page-class runs; screenshots read.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via repo CDP harness, with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (which exposes contentType on this build): both the missing-API branch and the real pre-158 classification (text raw / image empty / application minimized) observed and honestly rendered; page copy was corrected to match the measured old behaviour rather than an assumed one.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the application/xml explanation path on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: The 'spec-compliant rule at work on a non-application type' explanation branch could only be reached for application/* types on this build; re-check wording once a 158+ build classifies text/*+xml.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per changing status surface; announce results, not interstitial noise; tables need caption and header scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdict/detail routed through aria-live=polite <output>; result tables carry caption + th scope; per-URL lists use <details>/<summary> native disclosure.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls select and text input touch targets no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels via for/id above controls, aria-describedby for hints, 44px min targets, avoid type=number side effects.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: custom-subtype uses a labelled select + text input with aria-describedby hints; all buttons min-height 44px; long MIME tokens and URLs get overflow-wrap:anywhere — measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360px on every page.

guidanceConsulted.query: displaying async fetch results in table with loading and error states
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ground RUM-style measurement in the browser's own performance entries rather than parallel bookkeeping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: resource-audit derives every number from live performance.getEntriesByType('resource') — no shadow accounting; fetch failures surface as real error text, never fake rows.

summary: Free-form MIME tool over the real serve route, including the injection-rejecting 400 path (verified with 'text/bad mime;inject' → HTTP 400). Verified with the repo headless-Chrome CDP harness on both classes; explanations match the measured behaviour per branch.
